_comment: diagcomm-toolkit fixture sibling (1.13.0+). Owns the project's paths + options; values.json owns project + parameters. conftest.py copies this file into the synthesized inputs/ dir as DiagComm_config.json AND mirrors paths/options into runtime.DEFAULT_PATHS / DEFAULT_OPTIONS so lazy-seed reuses the fixture's dcom layout instead of the standard Bosch AUTOSAR pattern.
